cabinCategories.description: Royal Caribbean interior stateroom with queen or twin beds and efficient design. Ideal value for an Alaska adventure.
Classic ocean-view stateroom with large picture window. On Inside Passage scenic days, it's like having your own private viewing gallery.
Private balcony stateroom — watch Inside Passage wildlife and stunning scenery from your own personal deck.
Grand Suite with separate living room, whirlpool tub, and exclusive Royal Suite Class lounge and sundeck access.

portsOfCall.description: Embarkation at Pier 91 (Smith Cove Terminal). Voyager of the Seas — a Royal Caribbean classic — sets sail for Alaska.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

portsOfCall.description: Scenic cruising through the protected Inside Passage. Watch for whales, sea otters, and bald eagles from the expansive open decks.
portsOfCall.name: At Sea – Inside Passage Scenic

portsOfCall.description: Alaska's capital city. Mendenhall Glacier, whale watching, and the fascinating Alaska State Museum are all within reach.
portsOfCall.name: Juneau, AK

portsOfCall.description: Gold Rush history and mountain grandeur collide in Skagway. The White Pass & Yukon Route Railway ride is North America's most spectacular narrow-gauge journey.
portsOfCall.name: Skagway, AK

portsOfCall.description: Creek Street, totem pole parks, and outstanding fresh crab — Ketchikan delivers quintessential Alaska in a vibrant package.
portsOfCall.name: Ketchikan, AK

portsOfCall.description: A gorgeous evening in British Columbia's capital. High tea, horse-drawn carriage rides, and the stunning Inner Harbour await.
portsOfCall.name: Victoria, BC

reviewSnippet: A Royal Caribbean favorite for families: ice skating shows, a rock-climbing wall, and Adventure Ocean kids club keep sea days busy on the way to Alaska.
